name: Rock & Roll Pizza (Harley's Valley Bowl)
bio: Rock & Roll Pizza Bar is the pizza bar and live entertainment room inside harley's Valley Bowl on Cochran Street in Simi Valley, serving New York-style pizza, craft beer and cocktails. It hosts local bands each week, along with comedy, karaoke and line dancing.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from harleysbowl.com and @rocknrollpizzabar.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
